note: Every file below was read from the upstream repository at the listed commit; the strategies in strategies.py are reimplementations of those exact selection rules and prompts.

codex.modelled_path: local inline summarization (compact.rs::build_compacted_history), used when the provider has no remote compaction and the TokenBudget feature is off
not_modelled: Feature::TokenBudget compaction (compact_token_budget.rs, fresh context window, no summary)
history-notes extension (history/notes tools + thread hint): requires the Codex backend and a paid ChatGPT plan

retrieval_capability.summary: Codex ships a first-party conversation-history retrieval tool set in the history-notes extension: the `history` namespace exposes list_windows, list_items, read_item and search_contents to 'recover prior conversation after a context-window reset', plus a `notes` namespace and an automatically injected thread hint.
retrieval_capability.data_source: hosted Codex backend (alpha/history/v2/*, alpha/notes/v2/*), not local files
gating: Feature::TokenBudget and Feature::ContextManagement — both Stage::UnderDevelopment, default_enabled: false
provider supports_codex_backend_routes() and requires_openai_auth, with no env_key/bearer/provider-auth/aws
AuthMode::Chatgpt with plan Plus, Pro or ProLite
retrieval_capability.consequence: The measured Codex arm is its local fallback compaction without experimental context management. The history tools cannot be exercised with API keys or third-party OpenAI-compatible providers, so a like-for-like 'Codex + its own search' arm is not reproducible in this experiment.

opencode.modelled_path: summary + retained tail (core select/prompt + packages/opencode select/tail_start_id)
not_modelled: compaction.prune (in-place clearing of old tool output, disabled unless cfg.compaction.prune is set)
